body:
## Code review (AI-assisted)

Nice refactor overall — the split is clean, the parent is now a thin orchestrator, and the three children have single, well-scoped responsibilities. `OnPush`, `input.required`, and `output()` everywhere on the children is exactly the right shape for Angular 17+. The constants module is a good DRY win.

A few things to consider before merging — most of these are pre-existing behaviors that the refactor either inherits or now makes easier to fix, so feel free to defer some to a follow-up.

### Blocking / correctness
_None._ The PR description's invariants hold: `<app-display-cereals [cereals]="...">` still works (`app.html` unchanged), Escape handling still works (HostListener now lives on the dialog, which is only mounted while the modal is open — actually cleaner than before), and the add/edit submit paths still call the same service methods with the same payloads.

### Notable (worth fixing in this PR if possible)

1. **`CerealTable` shares one `arrow` signal across every sortable column.** This bug existed pre-refactor, but isolating sort state into the table is the obvious moment to fix it. As-is, clicking _Calories_ then _Protein_ shows the same arrow on _both_ columns, and the cycle direction "remembers" the previous column's state. Track the active sort column (`field`) alongside the direction, and render the icon only on the active column. See inline comment on `cereal-table.ts`.

2. **`CerealTable` shares one `isFocused` boolean across every cell input.** Same shape of bug — focusing _any_ cell removes `.bg-light` from _every_ cell. This is trivially solvable with CSS (`:focus`) and you can drop the field entirely. See inline comment on `cereal-table.html`.

3. **`CerealSearch` keeps a stale value when the user switches a row from a numeric item to a text item (or vice versa).** Pick `Calories`, type `5`, switch to `Mfr` — the stored value is still the number `5` even though the input is now `type="text"`. Reset / re-coerce the value in `onItemChange`. See inline comment on `cereal-search.ts`.

4. **`CEREAL_API_HOST` duplicates `cereal-service.ts`'s `BASE_URL`.** Two hard-coded `http://localhost:4300` constants will drift the day you point at staging/prod. Pull both from `src/environments/environment.ts` (and dervice `BASE_URL` from the host). See inline comment on `cereal-display.constants.ts`.

### Nits (defer if you want)

5. **`CerealRowSnapshot.self?: number` is declared but never read.** The original parent had a `self → shelf` note attached to that snapshot, but `loadFromCereal` never consults it. Either delete the field or actually fall back (`row.shelf ?? snapshot.self ?? null`). See inline comment on `cereal-form-dialog.ts`.

6. **`isLoggedIn` subscription in `DisplayCereals.ngOnInit` is never unsubscribed.** Pre-existing; service-scoped `BehaviorSubject` so it won't leak _the value_, but the component will keep getting callbacks after destroy (no-op today, footgun tomorrow). `takeUntilDestroyed()` is one line. See inline comment on `display-cereals.ts`.

7. **Spec stubs only verify `toBeTruthy()`.** Consistent with project convention, so OK to defer — but a refactor that promises "Inputs/Outputs only" is a great moment to lock in at least one event-emission test per child (e.g. `CerealSearch` emits the right `ISearchInputs` shape on Go, `CerealTable` emits a `SortChange` with the lower-cased field, `CerealFormDialog` emits `cancel` on Escape).

8. **Mixed input style.** `DisplayCereals` still uses `@Input()` while children use `input.required()` / `input()`. You called this out in the PR description (keep the public API stable) and that's a defensible reason, so this is just a flag for a future cleanup.

### Note on CodeRabbit
I tried to trigger `@coderabbitai full review` first to fold its findings in, but the CodeRabbit GitHub App isn't installed on this repo (no webhook, no bot response after a few minutes), so the review above is entirely manual. If you want CodeRabbit on future PRs, install it at https://github.com/apps/coderabbitai on `sudhansom/cerealizer-frontend` and re-run `@coderabbitai review` on this PR.

comments.body:
`[class.bg-light]="!isFocused"` together with `(focus)="isFocused = true"` on every cell means focusing any single cell strips `.bg-light` from **every** cell in the table. This was the behavior pre-refactor too, but it's a one-line CSS replacement now that the table is isolated:

```css
.form-control:not(:focus) { background-color: var(--bs-light); }
```

Then drop `isFocused`, `[class.bg-light]`, `(focus)`, and `(blur)` from this template and from `cereal-table.ts`.

`self?: number` is declared on `CerealRowSnapshot` but never consulted — the original parent left a comment about the API sometimes returning `self` instead of `shelf`, but `loadFromCereal` doesn't fall back to it (it uses `row.shelf ?? null`). Either drop the field, or actually wire the fallback:

```ts
shelf: row.shelf ?? snapshot.self ?? null,
```

If the API never sends `self`, deleting both the field and the comment-context will avoid confusing the next reader.
